metadata.bug: The paused divider branch holds the pulse output instead of clearing it.
metadata.trigger: While running, counter reaches COUNTER_MAX and raises one_sec_pulse; before the next posedge clk, start_stop goes low, so the pause branch executes while one_sec_pulse is still high.
metadata.effect: The pulse remains high. After resuming, later terminal-count assignments cannot create another rising edge, so the stopwatch stops receiving one-second ticks until reset.

proof: Inductively, a high variant pulse implies counter=0. During pause the signal may stay high but cannot rise. The first resumed edge clears it at count 0, long before the next terminal count. Both implementations have exactly the same rising pulses.
